Generate and check the type files of this directory's project: its product, paywall location and
perk slugs as types of your app's language, so a mistyped slug does not compile.

The files are listed under "types" in voidhash.json, each with its "language" (typescript, swift or
kotlin) and "output" path. Without any, one TypeScript declaration file is written to
voidhash.gen.d.ts.

A TypeScript file types the Voidhash SDKs the package.json in this directory depends on,
@voidhash/react-native and @voidhash/web, or @voidhash/react-native without either. It also lists
the project's feature flag keys, leaving archived flags out, and the text values of their variants;
a flag or variant added since the file was written is not in it.

Usage:
  voidhash types <command> [flags]

Commands:
  generate   Write the type files from the project as it is now.
  check      Fail when a type file is behind the project.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash types <command> --help' for more about a command.
